one_month_reasoning: The main event in the window is Q3 FY2026 earnings. FormFactor reported Q3 2025 on 2025-10-29 and Q1/Q2 2026 on 2026-04-29 and 2026-07-29 (8-K filing dates on EDGAR), so a report around 2026-10-28 is likely and would fall before 2026-11-01. One third-party calendar shows 2026-11-04, which would be outside the window, so the date is uncertain. Q3 guidance is $270M +/- $10M revenue and $0.86 +/- $0.09 non-GAAP EPS. The last two quarters beat the top of the range: Q2 came in at $258.2M / $0.82 against a $240M / $0.61 guide. Q4 should also see the first Farmers Branch production, with start-up costs moving into cost of goods sold. Another beat looks likely, but the stock has risen about 4x in a year and jumped about 10% on 2026-09-30 after a Deutsche Bank initiation (Buy, $200; second-source probe cards for Nvidia GPUs at TSMC), so a beat may already be priced in and the reaction could go either way. The Q4 guide and any gross-margin drag from the Farmers Branch ramp will set the direction. I centred the distribution near the current price (median about $149, a touch of positive drift for earnings momentum). I used a 1-month log sigma of 0.22, between the default 85%/3.5 = 24% and a slightly lower value, widened a little for the earnings event.

fair_value.method: Blend of FY2028 non-GAAP EPS of about $4.75 x 30x plus net cash ($147, 60%), NTM revenue of about $1.45B x 7x EV/sales ($132, 20%) and FY2028 FCF of about $300M at a 3% yield ($130, 20%), all as of Oct 2027; the blend is about $141.

methods.inputs: FY2028E non-GAAP EPS $4.75 x 30x forward P/E = $142.5, plus net cash of about $4.2/sh = about $147

inputs_detail.derivation: Q1 $0.56 + Q2 $0.82 (reported) + Q3 about $0.93 (guide midpoint plus a smaller beat than Q2's $0.21) + Q4 about $0.99

FY2027 revenue of about $1.30B (Q3 run-rate $1.08B x about 1.2 for HBM4, GPU second source and CPO) at a 26% net margin (Q2 non-GAAP net margin was 25%) on 80M diluted shares gives about $4.2. FY2028 at about $1.45B, with Farmers Branch gross-margin accretion that management expects by 2028, gives about $4.75. That is above one analyst's $4.25 FY2028 estimate (mid-Sept) and consistent with the 2030 target model of $1.6B revenue and 55% gross margin.

One analyst applied 40x to FY2028 EPS for a $170 target, and Deutsche Bank set $200. I haircut to 30x because, on my FY2027 estimate, the stock already trades at about 35x. The business is cyclical (SK hynix is 24% of revenue) and the multiple on a 4x run-up is likely to compress somewhat as growth normalizes.
Cash $109.8M + marketable securities $235.9M - debt of about $11.6M at 2026-06-27, on 79.6M diluted shares

bear.story: HBM/AI capex digestion in 2027 (SK hynix is 24% of revenue), the GPU second source ramps slowly, Farmers Branch start-up costs weigh on gross margin, and the multiple de-rates to about 22x on about $3.6 EPS. The stock round-trips about half its 2026 gain.

base.story: Steady beat-and-raise into FY2027 with revenue of about $1.3B, EPS of about $4.2 and an FY2028 view of about $4.75. The multiple compresses from about 35x to about 30x forward, so earnings growth offsets multiple compression and the stock ends roughly flat.

bull.story: The Nvidia GPU second-source share ramps toward about 20% (DB: more than $200M by 2028), CPO systems and HBM4 SmartMatrix share gains continue, gross margin moves toward 55% early, FY2028 EPS reaches about $5.8 and the stock holds about 38x plus cash.

thesis_break_reason: Around $95 (about 36% down), the stock would be pricing about 22-24x a stalled FY2027 EPS of about $4. That would most likely mean a fundamental break rather than volatility: an HBM order cut at SK hynix or Micron, failure to win or ramp the TSMC/Nvidia GPU probe-card second-source position, or gross margin stuck near 50% because of the Farmers Branch ramp.

reasoning: Primary documents: the Q2 FY26 8-K and 10-Q show a step change. Revenue was $258.2M (+31.9% y/y), non-GAAP GM 53.3% (+1,480 bp y/y) and non-GAAP EPS $0.82 (+$0.55 y/y), far above the $240M / $0.61 guide. Q3 is guided to $270M / $0.86. DRAM grew 49% (HBM was about 75% of that increase), Foundry & Logic 22% on HPC/networking, and Systems 44% on CPO. Customer concentration is high: SK hynix 24%, TSMC 11%. The balance sheet holds about $334M net cash and 78.1M shares outstanding. The 10-Q has Farmers Branch starting late Q4 FY26 and ramping through FY27. The Jan-2026 8-K restructuring (Carlsbad/Baldwin Park consolidation, $30-40M charges) supports margins. Management's 2030 target model is $1.6B revenue and 55% GM. The 2026-09-30 jump (+9.6% to $149.31): FormFactor filed no 8-K or press release that day (EDGAR filing list checked; latest filings were Form 4s). Press reports attribute the move to a Deutsche Bank initiation at Buy with a $200 target, citing FormFactor as the second qualified probe-card source for Nvidia GPUs at TSMC: sales starting 2H26, a TAM of about $0.5B, and a 20% share worth more than $200M by 2028. One wire says no verified reason, so the attribution rests on press reports, not company disclosure. Valuation: at $148 the stock is about 45x my FY2026E EPS of $3.30 and about 35x FY2027E of $4.2. My blended fair value of $141 for Oct 2027 sits slightly below spot: earnings growth roughly offsets multiple compression. For the distribution, I centred a lognormal near $150 with sigma of about 0.62, below the 85% trailing realized vol, which was inflated by the 4x re-rating. The right tail is slightly fatter, because the scenario mix (bear $80/25%, base $150/45%, bull $235/30%) has a mean of about $159. Research limits: consensus estimate and target feeds (Twelve Data, Alpha Vantage) were unavailable (plan or rate limits), and the company IR site and its deck PDF did not load, so the target model comes from call summaries.
